attempts.raw_response: the kingdom has thereby acquired a firm and loyal base upon which to build its future prosperity. It is therefore with satisfaction that we observe the increasing commercial activity between these territories, and the growing sentiment of mutual confidence which unites their peoples. The example thus set in Genoa demonstrates what may be achieved through just and enlightened government, and it is earnestly to be hoped that similar results may follow in other provinces now labouring under the weight of foreign domination. The cause of Italian unity, so dear to all true patriots, advances steadily, and your Lordships may rest assured that the government will continue to pursue those policies which have already produced such happy fruits in the western provinces.

pair.human_continuation:
Unfortunately the
Treaty of 1852 in regard to Denmark, and the engagements which
were entered into in the previous year, 1851, with respect to an
arrangement between Germany and Denmark, were in their operation
exceedingly unsatisfactory. It was declared, and has lately been
repeated in the Conference, that an attempt was made by the King of
Denmark, contrary to the engagements of 1852, and contrary also to all
sound policy, to make the people of Schleswig change their national
character, and so to interfere with their churches and schools as to
keep up a perpetual irritation, thereby violating the spirit of the
engagements between Denmark and Germany.
pair.prefix:
Your Lordships are aware that for many years
great discontent prevailed in Lombardy, which was only removed by the
separation of that province from Austria. On the other hand, in Genoa,
by the wise and patriotic conduct of the Kings of Sardinia, all the
objections, all the repugnance, which originally existed in Genoa
against their rule have been finally overcome and removed, and
Piedmont and Genoa are now in perfect harmony.
